name: Repair stable frequency sorting
prompt: Read README.md and the implementation. Repair the contract, add a new meaningful regression test file, and verify using the exact public command with source read-only. Report observed results.

public.logic.mjs: export function solve(x){const counts=new Map();for(const k of x.items)counts.set(k,(counts.get(k)||0)+1);return [...counts.keys()].sort((a,b)=>counts.get(b)-counts.get(a)||a.localeCompare(b));}
public.public.test.mjs:
import test from 'node:test';import assert from 'node:assert/strict';import {solve} from './logic.mjs';
const cases=[[{"items": []}, []], [{"items": ["a", "a", "b"]}, ["a", "b"]]];test('public contract',()=>{for(const [input,expected] of cases)assert.deepEqual(solve(input),expected)});

# Repair stable frequency sorting

Return unique input strings ordered by descending frequency, breaking ties by first appearance. Treat every string as a literal key.

The CLI accepts one JSON array argument and returns the corresponding JSON result array. Preserve the original public tests, CLI, and README. Add a new discovered regression test without changing original test bytes. Run the exact public verification command read-only after your final edit: `node --test`. No external dependencies are needed.
